brief: Compare the Malaysian, Thai and Indian groups over the first half of 2026

sections.title: Competitor Comparison: 1H 2026
questions: How did PETRONAS (Malaysia), GC (Thailand), and RIL (India) perform financially and operationally in the first half of 2026?
What are the key differences in revenue, profit, and other headline metrics among the three groups for 1H 2026?
Are there notable trends or events affecting their comparative performance in this period?
sections.tool_rationale: search_part_b_filings is needed to extract and compare the relevant financial and operational data for 1H 2026 from each group's filings.
sections.unanswerable_if: If any of the three groups (PETRONAS, GC, RIL) do not have filings covering the first half of 2026, or if the filings lack sufficient detail for comparison.

excluded.topic: Comparison of PETRONAS Chemicals Group (PCG) specifically
excluded.reason: The corpus contains only PETRONAS Group filings, not those of the listed chemicals subsidiary PCG.
Filings for the full year 2026 are not present; only 1H 2026 is available for PETRONAS, and the latest for GC and RIL may not extend into 2H 2026.
